events.did: locked the office door and unrolled his sleeves to convince himself the work was done
events.quote_anchor: As he climbed the stairs. As he continued down the hall, unrolling his sleeves in an attempt to convince himself the work was done.

events.did: counted to ten at the final threshold and then went into the house
events.quote_anchor: When he was confident he had his thoughts together, he counted to ten, and then went in.

events.did: knelt to pick up Ian's action figures, gaming pad and half-laid tracks and returned the toys to their bins
events.quote_anchor: He returned the toys to their respective bins and was about to restore the pillows to the couch when Iris called out from the kitchen.

events.did: planted a kiss on his wife's warm skin and said he was sorry he was late
events.quote_anchor: Gabriel bent his head to plant a kiss on her warm skin.

events.did: tasted the sauce Iris offered and called it perfect
events.quote_anchor: Perfect. An empty word—one that served no purpose, and one he almost never used.

events.did: cupped Gabriel's cheek, searched his face and asked whether he was home
events.quote_anchor: because Iris cupped his cheek, her hazel eyes—even they couldn’t choose a color—searching his face as she said, “Are you home?”

events.did: assured Iris he was home while she tapped the spoon against his shirtfront
events.quote_anchor: “I’m home,” he assured her with a smile. Iris made a thoughtful sound, tapping the clean edge of the spoon against his shirtfront

events.did: washed his hands at the sink on a footstool while humming the birthday song, then sent soap bubbles everywhere
events.quote_anchor: Ian had migrated to the sink and stood on a footstool washing his hands, humming the birthday song as he lathered each of his fingers.

relations.did: 是 Gabriel 的妻子，选新房子时只向他要了一个承诺：不把工作带回家
relations.quote_anchor: Iris extracted only one promise when choosing the new house—the same one she demanded when they first moved in together—that Gabriel wouldn’t bring his work home.

relations.did: 是 Gabriel 的儿子，管他叫 Dad，头发是深色的卷发
relations.quote_anchor: “Hello, Dad,” chimed Ian brightly as Gabriel passed a hand over his son’s dark curls.

relations.did: 在自家房子里开诊所：一楼是诊所，楼上两层是家人的家
relations.quote_anchor: And so, the first floor became Dr. Gray’s private practice, while the two above were Gabriel’s home.

relations.did: 要靠二十八级台阶在治疗师与丈夫、父亲两个角色之间切换
relations.quote_anchor: Which meant he had exactly twenty-eight steps to put down the weight of his sessions. To shed the role of therapist, and shift into the role of husband, father.

numbers.did: 从诊所到家要走 twenty-eight steps
numbers.quote_anchor: commute from Dr. Gray’s office to Gabriel’s house was twenty-eight steps.

numbers.did: 这 twenty-eight 步的分配：Five from the door to the bottom of the stairs. Twelve up. And eleven down the hall.
numbers.quote_anchor: Five from the door to the bottom of the stairs. Twelve up. And eleven down the hall.

numbers.did: four years ago 离开医院开自己的诊所，当时刚买了新房子
numbers.quote_anchor: When he left the hospital four years ago to open his own practice, they’d just bought a new house

numbers.did: 人生的前 first thirty years 一直拒绝被叫 Gabe
numbers.quote_anchor: Example: For the first thirty years of his life, Gabriel refused to be called Gabe.

numbers.did: 吃饭时 poured two glasses of wine 并感谢 Iris 做饭
numbers.quote_anchor: as they sat down to eat, and Gabriel poured two glasses of wine, and thanked her for cooking

numbers.did: 在厨房做饭，厨房是 three different shades of green
numbers.quote_anchor: He found his wife stirring onions in the kitchen—which was three different shades of green—while Ian sat coloring at the table.
